faehigkeiten.grund: Auslieferung wird je Abruf neu zusammengesetzt (adswizz vergibt je Abruf eine listeningSessionID, AIS leitet ueber hash_redirect um, Last-Modified liegt nur 25 s vor dem Abruf, Abruf laeuft ueber den Werbedienst simplecastaudio.com) - Byte-Offsets veralten (bei dynamischer Auslieferung sofort, gemessen 19.08.2026) und die Zeitachse verschiebt sich mit (eine Folge war 57 s kuerzer als 3,5 h zuvor), deshalb sind auch Sprungmarken in Sekunden unsicher

einzeiler: Survivors and families of the Annunciation Catholic School shooting share their stories.
kurzfassung: Following the tragic mass shooting at Annunciation Catholic School in Minneapolis, survivors, teachers, and family members share their experiences and memories. The episodes highlight the immediate terror, the profound trauma, and the enduring bonds forged within the community. Through intimate conversations, participants reflect on how they try to rebuild their lives and support one another.
stichpunkte: A mass shooting occurred at Annunciation Catholic School in Minneapolis on August 27th, resulting in the deaths of two children and injuries to nearly 30 people.
Teachers and students recount the harrowing moments of hiding under pews and hearing gunfire break through the stained glass windows.
First responders and emergency medical staff discuss the heavy burden of identifying victims and supporting grieving families.
First grade teachers share the challenges of returning to the classroom and helping severely injured students heal.
Family members and friends establish deep connections through shared grief, honoring the memories of those lost.

clips.hook: Children playing therapy instead of house
clips.text: The speaker notes that young children in the classroom now pretend to play therapy rather than traditional games like house or school.

clips.hook: A Mr. Rogers quote inspired a run toward danger
clips.text: Hearing a familiar advice phrase inside his head immediately pushed the individual to move directly toward the shooter instead of freezing.

clips.hook: A surprising sensation of love during gunfire
clips.text: Instead of experiencing sheer terror from the first shot to the last, the individual felt an unexpected physical sensation of warmth and love.

clips.hook: A severely injured child returns to school
clips.text: The youngest child to survive a severe mass shooting recovered from multiple head and spleen injuries and returned to class.

clips.hook: A turtle necklace holding a friend's ashes
clips.text: The speaker gifted a special piece of jewelry containing a portion of the deceased friend's remains as a token of remembrance.

beschreibung:
On August 27, 2025, a mass shooting at the Annunciation Catholic Church in Minneapolis injured dozens and killed two children. In the weeks and months after, survivors and their loved ones needed to talk about what had happened. In this episode, you’ll hear those conversations between students, teachers, first responders and family members — many happening for the first time.
